headline_marked: PM Tarique Rahman: [[Govt will let no obstacle stand in way]] of rebuilding country
headline: PM Tarique Rahman: Govt will let no obstacle stand in way of rebuilding country
summary: The Prime Minister emphasized that with public support, the BNP government will not be deterred from its mission to rebuild Bangladesh.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman stated that his government will not be deterred by any obstacle in its efforts to rebuild Bangladesh as long as it has the support of the people.
The Prime Minister made these remarks while interacting with women beneficiaries of the "Family Card" programme in Gournadi upazila of Barishal.
He called for support from all citizens, regardless of political affiliation, profession, or religion, to move the country forward together.
During the event, beneficiaries shared how the Family Card has eased financial hardships, helped manage household expenses, and supported children's education.
The Prime Minister expressed his goal to gradually extend the Family Card programme to every eligible woman across the country to empower women and improve their economic position.

He reiterated the government's commitment to building an inclusive society, stressing the importance of preserving the tradition of peaceful coexistence among Muslims, Hindus, Buddhists, and Christians.
Information and Broadcasting Minister Zahir Uddin Swapon and local leaders were also present at the programme in Barishal.

headline_marked: 4.1 million families to [[get Family Cards within a year]], says PM
headline: 4.1 million families to get Family Cards within a year, says PM
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman announced the expansion of the Family Card program to empower women and support low-income households.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman announced that 4.1 million families will receive Family Cards within the next year, based on current budget allocations.
The announcement was made during a Family Card distribution event in Gournadi's Batajar on Monday, July 13.

The Prime Minister stated that sufficient funds have been allocated in this year's budget to ensure the program's expansion, with a goal for all designated families to receive cards within five years.
He noted that 7,000 families in every upazila will be beneficiaries of the Family Card program.
The government is also focusing on making women economically independent and educated, offering free tuition up to honors level and scholarships for high-achieving students.
The Prime Minister emphasized a politics of inclusivity and humanity, stating that the government aims to move forward with people of all religions without discrimination.
He added that with the support of the people, no obstacle can stop the government from achieving its goals.
caption:
4.1 million families will receive Family Cards in the next year alone.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman announced that 4.1 million families will receive Family Cards within the next year, based on current budget allocations.

The announcement was made during a Family Card distribution event in Gournadi's Batajar on Monday, July 13.

The Prime Minister stated that sufficient funds have been allocated in this year's budget to ensure the program's expansion, with a goal for all designated families to receive cards within five years.

He noted that 7,000 families in every upazila will be beneficiaries of the Family Card program.

The government is also focusing on making women economically independent and educated, offering free tuition up to honors level and scholarships for high-achieving students.

The Prime Minister emphasized a politics of inclusivity and humanity, stating that the government aims to move forward with people of all religions without discrimination.

He added that with the support of the people, no obstacle can stop the government from achieving its goals.
